lead: A `uint` parameter refuses an `int` sweep value or an `int` index, and the diagnostic lands at the call, not the literal.
body: `Core\Str::repeat`'s count and both of `Core\Bytes::fill`'s arguments are `uint`, so `foreach ($lengths as int $n)` fails `E0401: expected uint, found int` at the call; `Core\Bytes::at` takes an `int` index while `Core\Bytes::length` answers `uint`, so `uint $i < length` fails at `at`. Declare a length list as `array<uint>` bound `as uint $n`, and carry an index as `int` with the length cast `as int`.
